اكتسحن (form VIII)
# اِكْتَسَحْنَ (iktasaḥna) /ik.ta.saħ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِكْتَسَحَ (iktasaḥa)
# اُكْتُسِحْنَ (uktusiḥna) /uk.tu.siħ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِكْتَسَحَ (iktasaḥa)
# اِكْتَسِحْنَ (iktasiḥna) /ik.ta.siħ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِكْتَسَحَ (iktasaḥa)
